```{r}

# 1. Fortæl R at bruge dit rigtige objekt (pylsq), men kalde det 'ps'
ps <- pylsq

# 2. Transformér til relativ overflod (procent) til brug i graferne
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRIN 1: Det geografiske overblik (PCoA-plot)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ord_bc <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Country") +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCoA: Geographical differences in microbiomes",
       subtitle = "Based on Bray-Curtis differences(Genus-level)",
       color = "Land")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRIN 2: Sygdom vs. Sundhed opdelt på lande
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ord_bc <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

# Plot med MESH ID som farve og den manuelle farveskala, der oversætter koderne
plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Disease.MESH.ID") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Country) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("D003093" = "#E41A1C", "D006262" = "#377EB8"),
    labels = c("D003093" = "Ulcerative Colitis", "D006262" = "Healthy Control")
  ) +
  labs(title = "PCoA: Ulcerative Colitis based divided by country",
       subtitle = "Divided by geography and healthstatus (MESH ID)",
       color = "Status")
```
```{r}
# 1. Filtrér data, så vi KUN beholder de syge (D003093)
ps_kun_syge <- subset_samples(ps_rel, Disease.MESH.ID == "D003093")

# 2. Beregn den nye ordination (PCoA) udelukkende på de syge patienter
ord_syge <- ordinate(ps_kun_syge, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

# 3. Lav plottet (Da der kun er data fra USA tilbage, farver vi f.eks. efter køn eller alder, 
# eller beholder Country for at vise, at kun USA er tilbage)
plot_ordination(ps_kun_syge, ord_syge, color = "Sex") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "PCoA: Kun syge patienter (Ulcerative Colitis)",
       subtitle = "Bemærk: Danmark er ikke vist, da kohorten kun indeholder raske",
       color = "Køn")
```



```{r}
top20_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
ps_top20 <- prune_taxa(top20_genera, ps_rel)

plot_bar(ps_top20, fill = "Genus") +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color=NA) +  
  facet_grid(Disease.name ~ Country, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Patienter / Testpersoner", y = "Relativ overflod (Procent)",
       title = "Top 20 dominating genuses",
       subtitle = "Divided by country (columns) and healthstatus (rows)")
```

```{r}
# Tæl hvor mange raske/syge der er i hvert land

```
```{r}

```
```{r}
# Lav et søjlediagram over antal testpersoner per land med den rettede vjust-funktion
ps %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Country, fill = Country)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = 'count', aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Land", y = "Number of testpersons", 
       title = "Distribution of the study's test subjects") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# STATISTISK TEST: PERMANOVA (RETTET VERSION)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Træk bakterie-matrixen ud og vend den korrekt
bakterie_matrix <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix")
if(taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) {
  bakterie_matrix <- t(bakterie_matrix)
}

# 2. Skudsikker konvertering af metadata til rent data.frame
metadata_stat <- data.frame(as(sample_data(ps_rel), "data.frame"))


# --- TEST 1: GLOBAL TEST (Hele datasættet) ---
# Tjekker om geografi (Country) og sygdom (Disease.MESH.ID) er signifikante
permanova_global <- adonis2(bakterie_matrix ~ Country + Disease.MESH.ID, 
                            data = metadata_stat, 
                            method = "bray")

print("--- GLOBAL PERMANOVA TEST ---")
print(permanova_global)

```
```{r}
# --- TEST 2: KUN USA ---
# Vi filtrerer data, så vi kun tester sygdomseffekten i USA
ps_usa <- subset_samples(ps_rel, Country == "United States of America")
bakterie_usa <- as(otu_table(ps_usa), "matrix")
if(taxa_are_rows(ps_usa)) {
  bakterie_usa <- t(bakterie_usa)
}

# Skudsikker konvertering af USA-metadata
metadata_usa <- data.frame(as(sample_data(ps_usa), "data.frame"))

permanova_usa <- adonis2(bakterie_usa ~ Disease.MESH.ID, 
                         data = metadata_usa, 
                         method = "bray")

print("--- USA PERMANOVA TEST ---")
print(permanova_usa)
```
